create: CREATE TABLE android_metadata (locale TEXT)
CREATE TABLE connected_apps_metadata (package_name TEXT,auth_status BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT(0),connected_account_id INTEGER,library_version TEXT,consent_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT(1))
CREATE TABLE deleted_local_locked_media (deleted_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, generation INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE )
CREATE TABLE downloaded_file_groups (file_group_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, last_interaction_time INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, backfill_time INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, deletion_status INTEGER DEFAULT NULL)

CREATE TABLE generic_connected_apps_metadata (
  connected_api INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  package_name TEXT,
  auth_status INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  account_id INTEGER,
  library_version TEXT,
  consent_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
)

CREATE TABLE imported_media_metadata (
      id STRING PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      display_name STRING NOT NULL,
      relative_path STRING NOT NULL,
      metadata BLOB NOT NULL
    , is_consumed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, is_album_state_consumed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE key_value (prefix TEXT NOT NULL, _key TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL, value_type INTEGER NOT NULL, collection_type INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(prefix, _key, value))

CREATE TABLE local_locked_media (_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, dedup_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, original_file_location TEXT, private_file_path TEXT NOT NULL, type INTEGER NOT NULL, capture_timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL, utc_timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL, timezone_offset INTEGER NOT NULL, composition_type INTEGER, is_micro_video INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, micro_video_offset INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, micro_video_still_image_timestamp INTEGER, processing_id INTEGER, width INTEGER, height INTEGER, overlay_type INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, is_vr INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, capture_frame_rate REAL, encoded_frame_rate REAL, oem_special_type TEXT, latitude REAL, longitude REAL, duration INTEGER, is_raw INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, mime_type TEXT, generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, size_bytes INTEGER, fingerprint_hex TEXT, filename TEXT, threepio_metadata_state INTEGER DEFAULT NULL )
CREATE TABLE locked_folder_metadata (version TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE media_store_extension(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, date_modified INTEGER NOT NULL, populated_columns INTEGER NOT NULL, is_animated INTEGER, photo_orientation INTEGER, burst_id TEXT, filename_burst_id TEXT, burst_is_primary INTEGER, drm INTEGER, fingerprint TEXT, fingerprint_size INTEGER, oem_special_type_id TEXT, photosphere INTEGER, video_width INTEGER, video_height INTEGER, video_captured_frame_rate REAL, video_encoded_frame_rate REAL, is_vr INTEGER, is_raw INTEGER, depth_type INTEGER, is_microvideo INTEGER, micro_video_offset INTEGER, burst_is_extra INTEGER, micro_video_still_image_timestamp_ms INTEGER, micro_video_duration_ms INTEGER, micro_video_metadata BLOB, adjusted_exif_date_time INTEGER, timezone_offset INTEGER, latitude REAL, longitude REAL, is_long_shot_video INTEGER, image_width INTEGER, image_height INTEGER, video_duration INTEGER, retry_count INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, next_retry_time INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, hdr_type INTEGER, burst_group_type INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, has_gainmap INTEGER, blanford_format INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, face_count INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, xmp_is_auto_enhanced INTEGER, iptc_credit TEXT, iptc_digital_source_type TEXT, threepio_provenance_metadata_state INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,g_file_metadata BLOB DEFAULT NULL, fingerprint_generation_modified INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, video_codec INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, camera_capture_session_group_id TEXT, has_smpte_2094_50 INTEGER DEFAULT NULL)

CREATE TABLE media_store_extra_slomo_transition (_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, content_uri TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, transition_data BLOB NOT NULL, modified_timestamp_utc INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -2147483648)
CREATE TABLE media_store_ids (media_store_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE media_store_sync_state_settings (
  _id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  media_store_ids_imported INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE TABLE mediastore_observer_version (
  observer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  account_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  version TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (observer_id, account_id)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE mediastore_sync (
  mediastore_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  generation_modified INTEGER,
  date_modified INTEGER,
  is_deleted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  batch_edge_marker INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  state_all_photos_initial INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  state_all_photos_secondary INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  state_mediastore_extension INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE TABLE mediastore_sync_account_state (
  mediastore_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  observer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  account_id INTEGER, notified_state INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (mediastore_id, observer_id, account_id)
) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE TABLE obsolete_mse_processor_ids(processor_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

CREATE TABLE prioritizer_task_frequency (
work_id TEXT NOT NULL,
timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL,
aggregate_runtime INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
task_run_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
task_succeeded_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
task_paused_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
task_failed_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
task_cancellation_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (work_id, timestamp)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE processing_mars (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, date_added INTEGER NOT NULL, file_name TEXT NOT NULL, is_pending INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, is_visible INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, av_type INTEGER NOT NULL, mime_type TEXT NOT NULL, private_file_path TEXT, progress_status INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, progress_percentage INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, restore_path TEXT, special_type_id TEXT, thumbnail_file_path TEXT, timezone_offset INTEGER NOT NULL, utc_timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE shared_on_device_mi (
          _id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
          fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
          model INTEGER NOT NULL,
          version INTEGER NOT NULL,
          failed INTEGER NOT NULL,
          results BLOB,
          UNIQUE (
            fingerprint,
            model,
            version
          )
        )
CREATE TABLE timezones (content_uri TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, timezone_offset INTEGER NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE video_transcode_probe (width INTEGER NOT NULL, height INTEGER NOT NULL, frame_rate INTEGER NOT NULL, decoder_name TEXT NOT NULL, encoder_name TEXT NOT NULL, probe_bitrate REAL NOT NULL, output_size INTEGER NOT NULL, motion_correction_factor DOUBLE NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY (width, height, frame_rate, decoder_name, encoder_name, output_size))

CREATE TABLE video_transcode_probe_v2 (width INTEGER NOT NULL, height INTEGER NOT NULL, frame_rate INTEGER NOT NULL, decoder_name TEXT NOT NULL, encoder_name TEXT NOT NULL, output_size INTEGER NOT NULL, input_motion_factor DOUBLE NOT NULL, renderer_type INTEGER NOT NULL, probe_bitrate REAL NOT NULL, motion_correction_factor DOUBLE NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)
CREATE TABLE watch_face_media (_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, media_id TEXT NOT NULL, node_id TEXT NOT NULL, position INTEGER NOT NULL )
CREATE INDEX app_local_lfolder_filepath_idx ON local_locked_media(private_file_path)
CREATE INDEX app_local_lfolder_gen_idx ON local_locked_media(generation, _id)
CREATE INDEX app_local_lfolder_procid_idx ON local_locked_media(processing_id)
CREATE INDEX content_uri_idx ON timezones(content_uri, timezone_offset)

CREATE INDEX date_modified_and_id_idx
 ON mediastore_sync(date_modified DESC, mediastore_id DESC)

CREATE INDEX date_modified_id_deleted_idx
 ON mediastore_sync(date_modified DESC, mediastore_id DESC)
 WHERE is_deleted = 1

CREATE INDEX date_modified_id_marker_idx
 ON mediastore_sync(date_modified DESC, mediastore_id DESC)
 WHERE batch_edge_marker != 0

CREATE INDEX fingerprint_model_version_failed_idx
        ON shared_on_device_mi (
          fingerprint COLLATE NOCASE,
          model,
          version,
          failed
        )

CREATE INDEX generation_modified_and_id_idx
 ON mediastore_sync(generation_modified DESC, mediastore_id DESC)

CREATE INDEX generation_modified_id_deleted_idx
 ON mediastore_sync(generation_modified DESC, mediastore_id DESC)
 WHERE is_deleted = 1

CREATE INDEX generation_modified_id_marker_idx
 ON mediastore_sync(generation_modified DESC, mediastore_id DESC)
 WHERE batch_edge_marker != 0
CREATE INDEX index_imported_metadata_consumed ON imported_media_metadata(is_consumed, id)
CREATE INDEX key_prefix_idx ON key_value(_key, prefix)
CREATE INDEX media_store_extension_fingerprint_idx ON media_store_extension(fingerprint)

CREATE INDEX mediastore_sync_state_account_id_idx
ON mediastore_sync_account_state(account_id)

CREATE INDEX observer_and_account_idx
 ON mediastore_sync_account_state(observer_id, account_id)
